notes.title: Big autumn update 1.0.5
notes.notes:
Big update with new content and major improvements!

[olist]
  The forest continues to fill with stories. Now even more dark secrets await you somewhere among the trees.
  Players complained that it was easy to get lost in the Forest. They endlessly fell into dead ends. Now the attentive wanderer can find his way!
  Now from any map you can easily and quickly return to the intersection of the Station. Explore and travel instead of roaming the same places! But remember: everything in the Forest has a price.
  Of course, many small bugs were found and fixed. You might not have known about them... Well, now you won't!
[/olist]

notes.title: Update 1.0.4
notes.notes:
I watched the video of the walkthrough - I saw that people have problems with some points.

- Reduced the duration of the first 2 days
- Fixed a note that could not be read
- The main menu no longer overheats your video card!

Enjoy the game and look forward to a big update for Halloween!

notes.title: Update 1.0.3
